sources.summary: No one wants to wait for a cup of tea. Scan, pay, wait for your number, take it away. The cup is warm, but how the tea came to be is nowhere to be seen. New tea beverages have pushed everything toward speed: faster launches, faster service, faster replication of the next store. A hit is outdated before it is even remembered. HEYTEA Craft Store wants to do something else: to slow down.
